create_nomic_bert_config: create a NomicBertConfig instance with default nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 style configuration
build_nomic_bert_model: build a NomicBertModel from a NomicBertConfig instance with random weights
access_model_config: access a model's configuration via the model.config attribute
initialize_nomic_bert_config: initialize a NomicBertConfig with custom hidden_size num_hidden_layers and num_attention_heads
set_rope_parameters: set rope_parameters and default_theta on a NomicBertConfig for rotary embedding configuration
